name: tanstack-hide
tagline: Hide the TanStack Devtools corner button.
description: Chrome extension that hides the floating TanStack Devtools trigger button, globally or per site, with a status dot on the toolbar icon. The devtools panel still opens with its hotkey.

positioning.audience: Developers building apps with TanStack Router, Query or Start
positioning.wedge: One switch hides the devtools corner button on every project and port, while the panel stays one hotkey away
alternatives: The devtools' own 'Hide trigger' setting (per app, in local storage)
differentiators: Set once for every project, port and profile
Panel keeps working via its hotkey
No flash of the button on load
Status dot on the toolbar icon
